scope: Training/integrity only; not an independent model-accuracy claim.
diagnostic_conclusions: Directional correction retains much more source TRAIN learning than scalar backtracking while preserving all baseline-correct TRAIN Top-1 labels.
Top-1 preservation alone permits severe margin collapse; four protected rows have margin below 1e-4.
Three baseline-correct TRAIN Top-5 memberships were lost; Top-5 reachability is not protected by the current objective.
next_hypothesis: Protect a fixed fraction of canonical Top-1 margins and baseline-correct Top-5 membership/margins rather than reusing a shrinking current-champion margin. This is unimplemented and unproven.
